changelog: - **Clearer run buttons.** In the run bar, Reset, Step and Play are redrawn and shown at their full size instead of squeezed, so their shapes are crisper; Play (Pause while running, Replay at the end) is filled with the accent colour, so the main action stands out. The buttons keep their place, height and names; in high-contrast mode the main button has a thicker edge. The phone's run bar is unchanged.
